title: Ticket sales continue for Auburn’s BRAVO Performing Arts Series!
topic_titles: []
---

The Auburn Parks Department oversees nearly 1,000 acres of parkland and more than 20 miles of trails. The Auburn Farmers Market operates seasonally from June to September at Les Gove Park. Auburn Parks, Arts & Recreation offers various activities for children, encouraging outdoor play. The Auburn Community & Event Center provides a Community Fitness Program featuring numerous classes, open gym access, and a weight and equipment room. Residents and visitors can enjoy a range of recreational opportunities in Auburn, including special events and arts performances. Ticket sales are ongoing for the BRAVO Performing Arts Series, which highlights the city's commitment to cultural activities.
